findings.criterion: Repair C (sheet safe-area) + H (safe area) + general geometry — safe-area handling in sheet/actionbar/nav/FAB.

Rows+zebra+dividers together is a double-encoded separation system but is the source language, not a repair violation.
findings.recommendation: Decide intentionally: if rows keep zebra, dividers may drop to border-soft at 50% alpha or be removed between zebra rows (source kept both — preserving is acceptable); document the single rule in data-display-system.md so downstream apps don't mix.

top_5: S2-01 (Repair C): the filter UI is still a permanent, horizontally scrollable chip row with single-select JS and a 'Clear filters' empty-state wired to it — no compact Filter control, no filter bottom sheet, no grouped choices/Apply/Reset/staged selections, no active-count summary.

S2-02 (Repair D): the featured KPI card's numbers break the sum relationship (hero 1,250,000 vs tiles 620,000+230,400=850,400) that the source pack's Two-Jars card had exactly (850,400=620,000+230,400), and no progress/relationship bar exists anywhere — the required summary-metric composition is missing.

S2-03 (Repair D/H): the featured 2-tile grid is silently clipped at 320px (56px) and 360px (16px) by .screen overflow:hidden, worsening to 69px in large text and 47/189px at simulated 130/200% scale — while responsive-geometry.md claims '138px tiles, verified no wrap' (formula omits the card's own padding; no truncation CSS exists on .tile-num).

S2-04/S2-05 (Repair E): row titles are truncation-ONLY (white-space:nowrap + ellipsis, no line-clamp despite docs preferring it) so long Arabic labels cannot wrap, and the gallery demonstrates no long Arabic label, no wrapped qualifier, and no trailing action/chevron in rows.

S2-06/S2-07/S2-08 (Repair H/C): only 100%/106% text modes ship (no 130/200); safe-area is absent from nav/actionbar/sheet/FAB and viewport-fit=cover is missing although responsive-geometry.md claims five safe-area surfaces; the sheet has no drag-to-dismiss and no 94vh snap (self-critique admits it), and the FAB demo overlaps the bottom nav instead of floating 80px above it (--fab-offset token unused).
